notes: I recognize the title as an existing arXiv/preprint paper but have no knowledge of its reviews or outcome; I reviewed it on its merits. The literature check failed: arXiv API returned HTTP 429 on both valid queries (one further query was refused for 5 concept words), so Phase 1.5 produced no kept results and all recommended references are marked [verify]. Skill ambiguities: (1) SKILL.md says the EIC rerun happens before --final but the task requires a separate before/after pair; fine. (2) The ICLR rating mapping prints two scales (0,2,4,6,8,10 and legacy) and 'official_rating' vs 'eic_rating' naming is easy to confuse with the venue rating. (3) Pool-position band for R3 (62) falls in the 55-69 'borderline' pool band while the script maps its composite to Overall 4 - consistent but the band boundaries (62 vs 55-61 score band) are easy to misapply. (4) Dataset papers with no experiments fit the rubric awkwardly: Experimental Validation is scored very low although the paper type does not necessarily involve experiments. (5) The report-check (Phase 1.6) says not to add new weaknesses, yet reviewers had already drafted them in one shared context, so the check is partly circular. Figures were unavailable; Figure 2 judgments are caption-based.
